note: The four arithmetic operations and remainder, learned from examples only. Helper plans (dadd, ge, gemask, csub) are ordinary building blocks a planner would list; none of them names a structure.

plans.name: xor
plans.description: bitwise exclusive or of two numbers

plans.name: add
plans.description: sum of two numbers with carry out

plans.name: sub
plans.description: difference x0 - x1 with borrow out

plans.name: lt
plans.description: whether x0 is less than x1

plans.name: shl
plans.description: shift a number left by one bit

plans.name: shr
plans.description: shift a number right by one bit

plans.name: ge
plans.description: 1 if x0 is at least x1, else 0

plans.name: gemask
plans.description: all ones if x0 is at least x1, else 0

plans.name: csub
plans.description: x0 - x1 if x0 is at least x1, else x0

plans.name: mod
plans.description: remainder of x0 by x1 (x0 if x1 is 0)

plans.name: div
plans.description: quotient of x0 by x1 (all ones if x1 is 0)

plans.name: avg
plans.description: floor of the mean of two numbers
